bandReport.notes: Items 1-38, contiguous, no gaps, no repeats. Item 1 starts at the top of p02-c1; item 38 ends whole at the foot of p14-c2. All seven pages are English. COLUMN CROPS: the automatic split is clean on every page; no question text crosses the gutter. Items that continue from c1 to c2 on the same page (9, 15, 28, 32, 37) were joined in reading order; on each the c2 continuation starts with the next option/line and no item number is missing. Stray letters at the left edge of c2 crops and faint Hindi show-through are edge artefacts and were ignored. FIDELITY (transcribed as printed, not corrected): item 6 prints 'A canon shoots' and 'The ball looses 70%'; item 8 'heat transfer mechanism does' (singular); item 30 'following structure is'; item 37 'following statement ... is NOT correct'; item 35(d) 'The material in the rings get condensed'; item 23 capitalises 'Guard cells'. Items 27 and 32 print 'Select the answer using the code(s) given below' (no 'correct'). Match-the-list items 19, 20 and 38 are pipe tables in the stem (each list unique to its item, so not context), with the printed column subheadings kept in the header; their code options are written 'A-n B-n C-n D-n' from the printed code grid. Item 25 and item 31 statement 2 print an en dash, kept. No figures in this band. CLASSIFICATION judgement calls: 2 (video compression formats) filed under Computer Fundamentals / Number Systems and Data Representation; 5 (greenhouse effect in a glass chamber) under Physics / Heat and Thermodynamics; 15 and 18 (glass manufacture, UV-protective glass) under Chemistry / Polymers, Plastics, and Materials Science with own subtopic labels; 16, 17, 20 (atomic number, endothermic process, unpaired electrons) under Chemistry / Physical Chemistry and Bio-geochemical Cycles with own subtopic labels; 35 (Nebular Hypothesis) under Physics / Astrophysics and Space Science / Theoretical Models.
